At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.\n\n\n\n\nABOUT THE JOB\n\nWe are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.\n\nAs a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.\n\nThe role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. Occasional weekend work may be required for customer trials, roadshows or events. We will provide reasonable notice wherever possible.\n\nWhat you'll do\n\n - Lead onboarding and hands-on training for new families and clinical partners receiving their Trexo devices.\n\n - Provide ongoing support to customers through regular check-ins, helping them use the device effectively and work towards meaningful goals.\n\n - Conduct hands-on Trexo trials with children and families at roadshows, conferences and other events across the UK and Europe.\n\n - Address daily customer queries via dedicated chat groups and manage support tickets.\n\n - Independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot the Trexo device, including basic technical, mechanical, and software checks.\n\n - Work with families and clinicians to establish meaningful goals and monitor relevant measures and progress.\n\n - Gather customer feedback to share with engineering and product teams to drive continuous product improvement.\n\n - Work closely with our global Customer Success and Sales teams to ensure a consistent customer experience.\n\n - Represent Trexo Robotics at clinical events, conferences and community-based activities.\n   \n   \n\n\nABOUT YOU\n\nWe are looking for a tech-savvy Physiotherapist who is comfortable working independently with advanced robotic equipment. At least 3 years' post-qualification experience working as a Physiotherapist or in a closely related clinical role.\n\n - Qualification as a Physiotherapist with current HCPC registration (or eligible to practice as a UK-licensed PT).\n\n - Clinical experience at a level broadly equivalent to NHS Band 6, or equivalent experience in private or independent practice.\n\n - Experience working in paediatric physiotherapy, ideally in a community-based setting.\n\n - Tech-savvy with the confidence to independently set up, adjust, and troubleshoot technical equipment.\n\n - Strong verbal and written communication skills with excellent empathy and patience.\n\n - Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 75% travel across the UK and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe.\n\n - Experience providing virtual care, telehealth or remote clinical support.\n\n - Familiarity with UK paediatric funding pathways, such as NHS Continuing Healthcare, Personal Health Budgets, Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs) or charitable funding.\n\n - Experience working with children with complex mobility needs, neurological conditions or physical disabilities.\n\n - Experience with assistive technology, rehabilitation technology, robotics, orthotics or other mobility devices.\n\n -
